notes: Seed http://www.co.crane.tx.us/ works over https (first attempts were refused by the fetch module after a robots.txt connection reset during proxy relay failures; it loaded after the retry window). Last-Modified values differ per file and look like real upload times; printed footer times disagree with upload times (noted per election), but all fall on election night. 2026 runoff undetermined (check 3 pending; wayback-data branch not on origin).
